achievement.432.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked 10 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.432.name: Concurent
achievement.433.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked 100 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.433.name: Concurent serios
achievement.434.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked 10 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.434.name: Vânător priceput
achievement.435.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked 100 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.435.name: [EN] Master Hunter
achievement.436.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked your very first monster in the cyclopedia.
achievement.436.name: Permis de vânătoare
achievement.437.description: Blestemul lunii pline transformă cetățenii inofensivi în fiare sălbatice. Dar cu ajutorul tău, Edron și Cormaya sunt în siguranță - în mod corect.
achievement.437.name: Peste Lună
achievement.438.description: L-ai învins pe Contele Miezului și i-ai distrus pompa de lavă!
achievement.438.name: Zilele lui sunt numărate
achievement.439.description: L-ai învins pe Ducele Adâncurilor și i-ai distrus pompa de lavă!
achievement.439.name: Duk It Out
achievement.44.description: [EN] You're a fast runner and are good at delivering wares which are bound to decay just in the nick of time, even if you can't use any means of transportation or if your hands get cold or smelly in the process.
achievement.44.name: Tocmai la timp
achievement.440.description: L-ai învins pe Baronul de Jos și i-ai distrus pompa de lavă!
achievement.440.name: [EN] Buried the Baron
achievement.441.description: Baronul de Jos, Ducele Adâncurilor și Contele Miezului nu mai sunt!
achievement.441.name: Moartea în adâncuri
achievement.442.description: Ai luat căldura și l-ai învins pe Vechiul Spawn din Morgathla!
achievement.442.name: flagelul scarabeilor
achievement.443.description: [EN] Exploring the depths of Tibia can be a dangerous task. Surprisingly, some crude wood planks, rusty nails and a tinged pot can offer a sufficient protection against the creatures lurking in the deep.
achievement.443.name: Pietruit și petic
achievement.444.description: [EN] Putting this candle stump on your new mount was kind of a waiting game. You're even tempted to call it whack-a-mole. But in the end you found a loyal companion for your journeys into the depths.
achievement.444.name: Sus pe Molehill
achievement.445.description: [EN] You truly are the grand master of verbal debate! Now going forth and putting this wisdom to good use in everyday life... is probably debatable.
achievement.445.name: Maestru dezbatetor
achievement.446.description: I-ai cerut căpitanului Charles să ia o scurtătură de câteva ori. Acum sunteți prea familiarizați cu insulele deșertice din toată Tibia.
achievement.446.name: Înalt și uscat
achievement.447.description: [EN] Tall trees, deep forests and and the beauty of Ab'Dendriel - you really know every corner of the elven lands now.
achievement.447.name: [EN] Elven Woods
achievement.448.description: Câmpuri de luptă antice, amazone și gloria lui Carlin - cunoști cu adevărat fiecare colț al tărâmului reginei Eloise acum.
achievement.448.name: Trăiască Regina
achievement.449.description: [EN] Strong fortresses, sprawling woods and ivory towers - you really know every corner of Edron now.
achievement.449.name: Cetatea lui Edron
achievement.45.description: [EN] You love playing jokes on others and tricking them into looking a little silly. Wagging tongues say that the moment of realisation in your victims' eyes is the reward you feed on, but you're probably just kidding and having fun with them... right??
achievement.45.name: [EN] Perfect Fool
achievement.450.description: Mine vaste, o fortăreață de orci și măreția Kazordoon - acum cunoști cu adevărat fiecare colț al continentului de nord-est.
achievement.450.name: Minele Piticilor
achievement.451.description: Temple vechi, un peisaj rural cu pajiști și splendoarea Thaisului - acum cunoști cu adevărat fiecare colț al tărâmului regelui Tibianus.
achievement.451.name: Toți Salutare Regele
achievement.452.description: Mlaștini umede, un deșert uscat și opulența Venore - acum cunoașteți cu adevărat fiecare colț al Estului Continental.
achievement.452.name: Bijuterie în mlaștină
achievement.453.description: [EN] A vast steppe, voracious ogres and dried out salt seas - you really know every corner of Krailos now.
achievement.453.name: Stepa căpcăunului
achievement.454.description: [EN] Lush meadows, colourful fairies and sentient stones - you really know every corner of Feyrist now.
achievement.454.name: Tărâmurile Viselor
achievement.455.description: [EN] You have combed the desert and searched the pyramid city of Ankrahmun.
achievement.455.name: Mamii este cea mai dragă
achievement.456.description: [EN] You journeyed through Darashia and the sea of sand around it, while fighting the perils of the desert.
achievement.456.name: Pașii lui Daraman
achievement.457.description: [EN] You have searched Port Hope and the jungle that thoroughly, that you are up to adoption by a friendly ape family.
achievement.457.name: Regele junglei
achievement.458.description: [EN] You've braved the perils of Yalahar and learned of its gloomy shadows of long gone greatness.
achievement.458.name: Splendoare antică
achievement.459.description: [EN] A pirate's haven and a burglar's hideout. You found your way around Liberty Bay and its surroundings - land, ho!
achievement.459.name: Ceasul Liberty Bay
achievement.46.description: [EN] Sometimes the biggest secrets of life can have a simple solution.
achievement.46.name: [EN] Mathemagician
achievement.460.description: [EN] You have expelled the fog of the unknown from the islands of Svargrond. Maybe not as first, but that's not what matters in the end.
achievement.460.name: Cursa spre Pol
achievement.461.description: De la stepa de sud prin Munții Dragonblaze și Câmpiile Amuce până la orașul interzis Razachai - acum cunoști cu adevărat fiecare colț al Zao.
achievement.461.name: Regatul șopârlelor
achievement.462.description: [EN] Braving a hive full of unimaginable proportions and its grotesque creatures on the surface is only one side of Gray Beach. Your full trip of the island also included a dive into the black nothingness of the deep sea, facing the wrath of the Njey.
achievement.462.name: Excursie la Plaja
achievement.463.description: [EN] Glooth is the substance that powers a whole continent and all its weird inhabitants, workshops and factories. You travelled this strange smorgasbord of curiosities in its entirety - just in time for tea.
achievement.463.name: [EN] Glooth Punk
achievement.464.description: [EN] A journey through a dreamscape of evil is no small feat. Yet you traversed the nightmarish lands of Roshamuul and live to tell the tale. Don't fall asleep now...
achievement.464.name: Vise întortocheate
achievement.465.description: [EN] Though you couldn't prevent the theft of the godbreaker knowledge, you still managed to fight off the invasion of the library and to kill the scourge of oblivion, a powerful servant of the enemy.
achievement.465.name: Eliberator de biblioteci
achievement.466.description: [EN] You checked out a strange temple deep in the jungles of Tiquanda. Spectulus was right, it was indeed overrun by strange fish-men you now call Deathlings.
achievement.466.name: [EN] Spectulation
achievement.467.description: L-ai învins pe Marele Maestru Oberon și pe rămășițele Ordinului Soimului, indiferent de șanse.
achievement.467.name: Soimul Milenar
achievement.468.description: [EN] You passion for reading was somewhat diminished by biting books and aggressive quills. But this flying specimen proved to be a loyal companion. Never judge a book by its cover!
achievement.468.name: [EN] Bibliomaniac
achievement.469.description: [EN] Wielding dangerous knowledge as well as the sword is your expertise. You have proven yourself versatile in all manner of situations.
achievement.469.name: Magul de luptă
achievement.47.description: [EN] Delivering letters and parcels has always been a secret passion of yours, and now you can officially put on your blue hat, blow your post horn and do what you like to do most. Beware of dogs!
achievement.47.name: [EN] Archpostman
achievement.470.description: [EN] As a true globetrotter you can now show your colours proudly with this extraordinary outfit.
achievement.470.name: Călătorit pe scară largă
achievement.471.description: [EN] You don't just have a permission to ride a rift runner, you literally went through hell and earned it!
achievement.471.name: Conducerea Riftului
achievement.473.description: [EN] Not only did you master the battlefield as a mage, you were also induced to the most inner secrets of the art of magical warfare and prevailed.
achievement.473.name: Mage de luptă exaltat
achievement.474.description: [EN] Wisely contributing your resources to areas, you pushed creatures to maximum effect, allowing improved respawn for everyone! Well done!
achievement.474.name: Zone de efect
achievement.475.description: [EN] You figured out the right order of spells in the buried cathedral, how enchanting!
achievement.475.name: Legat Nodul
achievement.476.description: [EN] You found the Seven Keys to unlock ... no, not the seven seas. But at least seven doors in the realm of dreams.
achievement.476.name: Păstrătorul celor 7 Chei
achievement.477.description: [EN] You became an acquaintance of the courts of dreams and acquired the right to display your new status and title of 'dream warrior'.
achievement.477.name: Războinicul de vis
achievement.478.description: [EN] Your lantern was too bewitching for a hibernal moth. It couldn't withstand and follows you, the bearer of the lantern, now.
achievement.478.name: Şoptătorul de molii
achievement.479.description: [EN] You caught a lacewing moth with your lantern. It will follow you in companionship as the bearer of the lantern will be its guide through the darkness now.
achievement.479.name: Catcher de lacewing
achievement.48.description: [EN] You don't believe in romance to be a coincidence or in love at first sight. In fact - love potions, bouquets of flowers and cheesy poems do the trick much better than ever could. Keep those hormones flowing!
achievement.48.name: Matchmaker
achievement.480.description: [EN] This sleigh is not driven by magic but pushed by a percht. Hopefully you two get along well together...!
achievement.480.name: Fără sanie deschisă cu cai
achievement.481.description: Dar poți fi cu adevărat unul dintre ei?
achievement.481.name: Raider în întuneric
achievement.482.description: [EN] You are the slayer of the ancient nightmare beast and prevented the nightmare to spread its madness.
achievement.482.name: Prinzător de vise
achievement.483.description: Ai învins numeroși campioni în arenă în numele Curții de Vară.
achievement.483.name: Campion al verii
achievement.484.description: Ai învins numeroși campioni în arenă în numele Curții de Iarnă.
achievement.484.name: Campion al iernii
achievement.486.description: [EN] You literally put everything in that cauldron except lilac and gooseberries.
achievement.486.name: Vrăjitor
achievement.487.description: [EN] Unmasking spies, killing demons, discovering omens, solving puzzles and fighting ogres, manticores and feral sphinxes. - Nobody said it was easy to become a gryphon rider.
achievement.487.name: [EN] Gryphon Rider
achievement.488.description: [EN] Granted, you didn't carve those lifelike animal figurines yourself. But helping a medusa to find proper objects and even watching her using her petrifying gaze is almost as rewarding.
achievement.488.name: Ucenic sculptor
achievement.489.description: Te-ai asigurat că echilibrul dintre soare și mare este păstrat în Kilmaresh. Orașul de Aur Issavi nu vă va uita favoarea.
achievement.489.name: Soare și Mare
achievement.49.description: [EN] You're one of the few Tibians who Armenius chose to actually show his true face to - and he made you fight him. Either that means you're very lucky or very unlucky, but one thing's for sure - it's extremely rare.
achievement.49.name: Adevărata Lui Față
achievement.490.description: [EN] You ended the regn of Scarlett Etzel. All-seeing yet blind, ever powerful yet ultimately helpless, she never got a second chance to truly see. Or has she...
achievement.490.name: Un studiu în Scarlett
achievement.491.description: [EN] What draws things to other dimensions, one wonders. You read the almanac at just the right spot to end up... where, of all places? That is the problem with dimensional travel: you will never know. Or you have always known. And everything in between.
achievement.491.name: [EN] Avid Spectral Reader
achievement.492.description: [EN] You did the hippo population of Kilmaresh a great favour. A well-fed hippo is a happy hippo.
achievement.492.name: [EN] Hippofoddermus
achievement.493.description: I-ai învins pe Lich Knights și ai devenit mâna Inchiziției, având voie să poarte hainele lor speciale.
achievement.493.name: [EN] Inquisition's Hand
achievement.494.description: Creaturi mitice, catacombe uitate și Orașul de Aur - cunoști cu adevărat fiecare colț al Kilmaresh acum.
achievement.494.name: Gloria Imperiului
achievement.495.description: Îmbrăcămintea ta specială, acordată exclusiv unei Mâini dedicate a Inchiziției, este acum completă.
achievement.495.name: Brațul Inchiziției
achievement.496.description: [EN] You proudly wear the traditional Orcsoberfest garb, same as it ever was and as it always will be.
achievement.496.name: [EN] Traditionalist
achievement.497.description: Să călăriți un butoi de bere tradițional de la Orcsoberfest este o experiență o dată în viață. Berea se vinde separat.
achievement.497.name: Fă o rostogolire!
achievement.499.description: [EN] The Orcsoberfest is not only known for its traditional food, beer and customs but also fun events and excitement! You took part in all of that and can now truly say: "I survived!"
achievement.499.name: Orcsoberfest Bine ați venit
achievement.5.description: [EN] Simple hams and bread merely make you laugh. You're the master of the extra-ordinaire, melter of cheese, fryer of bat wings and shaker of shakes. Delicious!
achievement.5.name: Maestru culinar
achievement.50.description: [EN] People with sharp canine teeth better beware of you, especially at nighttime, or they might find a stake between their ribs. You're a merciless vampire hunter and have gathered numerous tokens as proof.
achievement.50.name: Razing!
achievement.500.description: [EN] You made acquaintance with the Thaian. A strange contemporary with a dark history. No man but a derivate of greed and obsession.
achievement.500.name: Prospectre
achievement.501.description: [EN] You have tamed the ghostly mists to do your bidding. For now ...
achievement.501.name: Nimic în afară de aer cald
achievement.502.name: Verminbane
achievement.503.description: Teme-te de mine, monștri! Urmează alte omoruri!
achievement.503.name: [EN] Monsterhunter
achievement.504.description: [EN] Having hunted and bested them all, you live for the thrill of the hunt!
achievement.504.name: Taskmaster
achievement.505.description: [EN] Now you are able to wander around Tibia wearing an angst-inducing vestment.
achievement.505.name: Coșmar pe strada principală
achievement.506.description: [EN] A true beastmaster learns the language of his animal companions. Now you as well can bolster your unique bond with nature and help preserve the balance of life as a proud falconer.
achievement.506.name: Şoimar
achievement.507.description: [EN] Champion of the wildlands, a swift strider among the creatures of the wild. The elegant nature of the gallop, this envoy of speed has mastered, indicates the precise understanding of its terrain and environment.
achievement.507.name: Eleganță de stepă
achievement.508.description: [EN] Adventurous beyond death, you travelled the Netherworld. Although you had just the ghost of a chance you survived and even came back from the realm of the dead.
achievement.508.name: Beyonder
achievement.51.description: [EN] Robbing, inviting yourself to VIP parties, faking contracts and pretending to be someone else - you're a jack of all trades when it comes to illegal activities. You take no prisoners, except for the occasional goldfish now and then.
achievement.51.name: Maestru Hoț
achievement.510.description: [EN] If a pride of lions and a pack of hyaenas feud, it is not called a catfight but a ... whatsoever. For sure, it caused a lot of drama in the Darama Desert.
achievement.510.name: Dramă în Darama
achievement.511.description: A făcut cunoștință cu trei frați Fitz.
achievement.511.name: Malefitz
achievement.512.description: Ai învins duo-ul malefic Drume and Fugue și ai restabilit ordinea în orașul asediat Bounac. Ai cucerit fortăreața exotică a Ordinului Cobrei și ai învins cavalerii strigoi ai Ordinului șoimului. Un adevărat cavaler la inimă și la minte.
achievement.512.name: Lionheart
achievement.513.description: [EN] Brought back to the realm of the living this magnificent creature will carry you through death and everything that lays beyond.
achievement.513.name: [EN] Soul Mender
achievement.514.description: [EN] Brought back to the realm of the living this magnificent creature will carry you through death and everything that lays beyond.
achievement.514.name: Ai puterea cailor
achievement.515.description: [EN] You defeated the manifestation of Goshnar's evil traits by fighting your way through beasts you didn't even want to imagine. It transformed you and now you can also look the part.
achievement.515.name: Eliberează Bestia
achievement.516.description: [EN] You helped Domizian and thus proved yourself worthy to enter the werelion sanctum underneath Lion's Rock. You faced the mighty werelions there and one of the rare white lions even chose to accompany you.
achievement.516.name: Ei bine, leu!
achievement.518.description: Când vă aflați în Rascacoon, faceți ca Rascoohanii!
achievement.518.name: Rascoohan onorific
achievement.519.description: [EN] Riding around on this squishy companion gives you the feeling of flying through the air... uhm... swimming through the seven seas!
achievement.519.name: Eliberează Krakenul
achievement.52.description: Ai ajutat să aduci la viață Prințesa Buttercup, Doctor Dumbness și Lucky the Wonder Dog - și probabil că vei visa la ei în seara asta, deoarece ți-ai memorat perfect replicile. Ce .. bucată specială de... scenariu.
achievement.52.name: Actor amator
achievement.521.description: [EN] You are not exactly the Pied Piper of Hamelin but at least you managed to fend off a decent amount of pirats and helped to keep them out of the cities.
achievement.521.name: Pied Piper
achievement.522.description: L-ai învins pe Megasylvan Yselda în urma amenințării carnisilvanelor adormite din adâncul Bounac.
achievement.522.name: Woodcarver
achievement.523.description: [EN] Yselda forever stands watch against the carnisylvan menace. Ever awake, waiting in the dark, her heart longs to be united with her king once again. Deep empathy let a hero to bring her Kesar's tulip as a token of his love. That hero was you.
achievement.523.name: Cavalerismul Bounacean
achievement.524.description: [EN] Your thirst for knowledge is insatiable. In the task of helping your gnomish friends, flawless execution is just the icing on the cake.
achievement.524.name: [EN] Knowledge Raider
achievement.525.description: Nu a fost prima dată când ai ajutat Sapphire Blade sau Midnight Flame cu o sarcină dificilă. Acum puteți purta hainele Kilmareshian, precum și lama de tagralt și voalul brodat cu ochi al văzătorilor, ca semn al recunoștinței lui Issavi.
achievement.525.name: Cetăţean al lui Issavi
achievement.526.description: Eforturile tale continue de a păstra în siguranță Bounac și oamenii din Kesar cel Tânăr ți-au câștigat un loc permanent la curtea regală ca consilier al regelui.
achievement.526.name: Consiliul Regelui
achievement.527.description: [EN] Since it is fireproof, this flaming creature feels right at home in raging infernos. But remember: just because it doesn't burn, you still do!
achievement.527.name: Fierbinte pe traseu
achievement.528.description: [EN] Equipped with the shell of a tortoise and claws of a lobster this insect like companion will help you through every hardship.
achievement.528.name: Shell Facem o plimbare
achievement.529.description: [EN] This mighty pachyderm will march into battle as if just taking its Sunday stroll. The cost of friendship was only a few drome points!
achievement.529.name: [EN] Phantastic!
achievement.53.description: Ai stins flăcările Spiritului Focului în arena din Svargrond. Luptele din arenă sunt pentru tine - corecte, pătrate, cu reguli simple și bătălii unu-la-unu.
achievement.53.name: Scrapper
achievement.530.description: [EN] You have braved the searing heat in the tunnels deep below Kazordoon and vanquished the Brainstealer. The voices inside your head are finally silenced.
achievement.530.name: Unora le place fierbinte
achievement.531.description: [EN] Congratulations to your very first achievement! ... Well, not really. But imagine, it is. Because at this point during your journey into Tibia's past, achievements have been introduced.
achievement.531.name: Prima realizare
achievement.532.description: [EN] Just everyone will be crazy about you if you are wearing this formal dress. They will come running, promise!
achievement.532.name: Îmbrăcat ascuțit
achievement.533.description: [EN] This glooth-driven locomotive will bring you to any party in the blink of an eye.
achievement.533.name: Sofer de motor
achievement.534.description: Ai stăpânit focul și ai îmblânzit un supervulcan!
achievement.534.name: Foc prietenos
achievement.535.description: [EN] Alas! What could be more beautiful and satisfying than bringing two loving hearts together? So romantic!
achievement.535.name: Planificator de nunta
achievement.536.description: [EN] You really were as busy as a beaver in order to help the nagas. Enjoy some eager company!
achievement.536.name: Castorul departe
achievement.537.description: [EN] Mysterious nagas, a vibrant jungle and a sinking island - you really know every corner of Marapur now.
achievement.537.name: Groapa șerpilor
achievement.538.description: Pentru unii nu poate fi suficient de periculos.
achievement.538.name: Regalitatea lui Hazard
achievement.539.description: [EN] Step by step you discovered many of the secrets hidden in the world, thus gaining the right to wear the Discoverer outfit and hat. Made-to-measure for a brave traveller of the Tibian wilds.
achievement.539.name: Măsurând lumea
achievement.54.description: L-ai nimicit pe Orcus cel Crudul în Arena Svargrond. Ești încă puțin verde în spatele urechilor, dar există un potențial mare.
achievement.54.name: Greenhorn
achievement.540.description: [EN] Don't get carried away by your success. Get carried away by your Ripptor.
achievement.540.name: Ripp-Ripp Ura!
achievement.541.description: [EN] Combining unabating courage in combat and respect for the traditions and culture of the ancient Iks earned you the honours of true Aucar.
achievement.541.name: Războinicul Iks
achievement.542.description: [EN] You accomplished the impossible and created 16 mutagens of corresponding colours.
achievement.542.name: Mutagenius
achievement.543.description: Numai călărețul său poate iubi această abominație a unei monturi.
achievement.543.name: Cel mai ciudat lucru
achievement.544.description: [EN] You defeated the embodiments of decay and live to tell the tale, wear the rotting attire of the unfaltering defender proudly.
achievement.544.name: Complet Decăzut
achievement.545.description: [EN] Sly as a fox, quiet as a mouse - the perfect mount for a stealthy foray.
achievement.545.name: Ca Vulpea și șoarecele
achievement.546.description: [EN] Withstanding both filth and desolation of the rotten darkness that corrupted the very core of this world, you embodied the weapon of purity and light to defy all that was tainted. This spirit will continue guide you on all future paths.
achievement.546.name: Spiritul Purității
achievement.547.description: [EN] You unveiled the secret plot of the Mitmah who stole away an entire civilisation for their own entertainment. Let the death of their outpost vanguard be an eternal lesson to them.
achievement.547.name: Muzeul vizitator
achievement.548.description: [EN] Proving your true worth to a mystic creature like the jaguar, king of the hunt, granted you not only respect but also its heart.
achievement.548.name: Predator mistic
achievement.549.description: [EN] You almost feel as cool as a raccoon. Now, where's the trash?
achievement.549.name: Regula lui Raccool
achievement.55.description: L-ai trimis pe Obliverator în uitare în arena din Svargrond și ai învins alți nouă inamici periculoși pe drum. Toți salută Warlord din Svargrond!
achievement.55.name: Domnul războinic din Svargrond
achievement.56.description: [EN] You're one of the brave heroes to face and defeat the mysterious demon oak and all the critters it threw in your face. Wielding your blessed axe no tree dares stand in your way - demonic or not.
achievement.56.name: Herbicide
achievement.57.description: [EN] You've daringly jumped into the infamous Annihilator and survived - taking home fame, glory and your reward.
achievement.57.name: [EN] Annihilator
achievement.58.description: [EN] You were able to fight your way through the countless hordes in the Demon Forge. Once more you proved that nothing is impossible.
achievement.58.name: Stăpânul Nexusului
achievement.59.description: [EN] You're a lord or lady of the dance - and not afraid to use your skills to impress tribal gods. One step to the left, one jump to the right, twist and shout!
achievement.59.name: Dansator talentat
achievement.6.description: [EN] You found a hundred beautiful pearls in large sea shells. By now that necklace should be finished - and hopefully you didn't get your fingers squeezed too often during the process.
achievement.6.name: Căutătorul de cochilii
achievement.60.description: [EN] With a perfectly harmless smile, you tricked all the funny guys into eating your exploding cookies. Next time you pull this prank, consider wearing a Boy Scout outfit to make it even better.
achievement.60.name: Permiteți cookie-uri?
achievement.61.description: [EN] You've touched all thrones of the Ruthless Seven and absorbed some of their evil spirit. It may have changed you forever.
achievement.61.name: Nemilos
achievement.62.description: [EN] You won the merciless 2 vs. 2 team tournament on the Isle of Strife and wiped out wave after wave of fearsome opponents. Death or victory - you certainly chose the latter.
achievement.62.name: Campion de Chazorai
achievement.63.name: Wayfarer
achievement.64.description: [EN] One thing's for sure: You definitely love swimming. Hanging out on the beach with your friends, having ice cream and playing beach ball is splashingly good fun!
achievement.64.name: Waverider
achievement.65.description: [EN] Music just comes to you naturally. You feel comfortable on any stage, at any time, and secretly hope that someday you will be able to defeat your foes by playing music only. Rock on!
achievement.65.name: Rockstar
achievement.66.description: [EN] You certainly have your ways when it comes to acquiring money. Many of them are pink and paved with broken fragments of porcelain.
achievement.66.name: Colectator de indemnizatii
achievement.67.description: [EN] The breeze in your hair, your fingers clutching the rim of your carpet - that's how you like to travel. Faster! Higher! And a looping every now and then.
achievement.67.name: High-Flyer
achievement.68.description: [EN] You love getting your hands wet and dirty - and covered with clay. Your perfect sculpture of Brog, the raging Titan is your true masterpiece.
achievement.68.name: Luptător de lut
achievement.69.description: [EN] You probably don't know anymore how you really look like - usually when you look into a mirror, some kind of monster stares back at you. On the other hand - maybe that's an improvement?
achievement.69.name: [EN] Masquerader
achievement.7.description: [EN] If someone lost a random thing in a random place, you're probably a good person to ask and go find it, even if you don't know what and where.
achievement.7.name: Rucsac Turist
achievement.70.description: [EN] Under the sea - might not be your natural living space, but you're feeling quite comfortable on the ocean floor. Quara don't scare you anymore and sometimes you sleep with your helmet of the deep still equipped.
achievement.70.name: [EN] Deep Sea Diver
achievement.71.description: [EN] Running barefoot across ember is not for you! You do it the elegant way. Yet, you're kind of drawn to fire and warm surroundings in general - you like it hot!
achievement.71.name: Firewalker
achievement.72.description: [EN] Ah, the smell of the sea! Standing at the shore and casting a line is one of your favourite activities. For you, fishing is relaxing - and at the same time, providing easy food. Perfect!
achievement.72.name: Aici, Fishy Fishy!
achievement.73.description: [EN] If someone gives you seeds, you usually grow a beautiful plant from it within a few days. You like your house green and decorated with flowers. Probably you also talk to them.
achievement.73.name: Degetul mare verde
achievement.74.description: [EN] Your local magic trader considers you one of his best customers - you usually buy large stocks of potions so you won't wake up in the middle of the night craving for more. Yet, you always seem to run out of them too fast. Cheers!
achievement.74.name: Dependent de poțiune
achievement.75.description: [EN] You love to hang out in cold surroundings and consider ice the best material to be shaped. What a waste to use ice cubes for drinks when you can create a beautiful mammoth statue from it!
achievement.75.name: Sculptor de gheață
achievement.76.description: [EN] Your home is your castle - and the furniture in it is just as important. Your friends ask for your advice when decorating their houses and your probably own every statue, rack and bed there is.
achievement.76.name: Decorator de interior
achievement.77.description: [EN] Sometimes you feel there's a gremlin in there. So many lottery tickets, so many blanks? That's just not fair! Share your misery with the world.
achievement.77.name: Jinx
achievement.78.description: [EN] That's almost too much luck for one person. If something's really, really rare - it probably falls into your lap sooner or later. Congratulations!
achievement.78.name: Diavolul norocos
achievement.79.description: [EN] You're an aspiring marble sculptor with promising skills - proven by the perfect little Tibiasula statue you shaped. One day you'll be really famous!
achievement.79.name: Marblelous
achievement.8.description: [EN] You don't care for rules that others set up and shape the world to your liking. Having left behind meaningless conventions and morals, you prize only the power you wield. You're a master of your fate and battle to cleanse the world.
achievement.8.name: Doamne groaznic
achievement.80.description: [EN] Oh my god, it's a paaaaaaaaaaaarty! You're always in for fun, friends and booze and love being the center of attention. There's endless reasons to celebrate! Woohoo!
achievement.80.name: Animal de petrecere
achievement.81.description: [EN] You love the moment right before your rocket takes off and explodes into beautiful colours - not only on new year's eve!
achievement.81.name: Focuri de artificii pe cer
achievement.82.description: [EN] There... is... simply... no... better... way - than to travel on the back of a turtle. At least you get to enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Laguna.
achievement.82.name: Rapid ca o broasca testoasa
achievement.83.description: [EN] If you see a rusty item, you can't resist polishing it. There's always a little flask of rust remover in your inventory – who knows, there might be a golden armor beneath all that dirt!
achievement.83.name: Polizor
achievement.84.description: [EN] You’ve probably never gotten seasick in your life — you love spending your free time on the ocean and covered quite a lot of miles with ships. Aren’t you glad you didn’t have to swim all that?
achievement.84.name: Kobold de navă
achievement.85.description: [EN] Travelling with the dwarven steamboats through the underground rivers is your preferred way of crossing the lands. No pesky seagulls, and good beer on board!
achievement.85.name: [EN] Steampunked
achievement.86.description: [EN] Aren't you just perfectly, wonderfully, beautifully gorgeous? You can't pass a mirror without admiring your looks. Or maybe doing a quick check whether something's stuck in your teeth, perhaps?
achievement.86.name: vanitate
achievement.87.description: [EN] Fortune tellers and horoscopes guide you through your life. And you probably wouldn't dare going on a big game hunt without your trusty voodoo skull giving you his approval for the day.
achievement.87.name: Superstiţios
achievement.88.description: [EN] You served Yalahar - but you didn't seem so sure whom to believe on the way. Both Azerus and Palimuth had good reasons for their actions, and thus you followed your gut instinct in the end, even if you helped either of them. May Yalahar prosper!
achievement.88.name: Turncoat
achievement.89.description: [EN] Your little statues of Tibiasula have become quite famous around Tibia and there's few people with similar skills when it comes to shaping marble.
achievement.89.name: Nebunia de marmură
achievement.9.description: [EN] You proved yourself - not only in your dreams - and possess a strong and spiritual mind. Your valorous fight against demons and the undead plague has granted you the highest and most respected rank among the Nightmare Knights.
achievement.9.name: [EN] Lord Protector
achievement.90.description: Sculptul lui Brog, Titanul furios, este pasiunea ta secretă. Numeroase mici statui de lut perfecte cu numele tău pe ele pot fi găsite peste tot în jurul Tibiei.
achievement.90.name: [EN] Clay to Fame
achievement.91.description: [EN] Take an ice cube and an obsidian knife and you'll very likely shape something really pretty from it. Mostly cute little mammoths, which are a hit with all the girls.
achievement.91.name: Rece ca gheața
achievement.92.description: [EN] You love fish - but preferably those caught in the cold north. Even though they're hard to come by you never get tired of picking holes in ice sheets and hanging your fishing rod in.
achievement.92.name: Gust rafinat
achievement.93.description: [EN] When it comes to interracial understanding, you're an expert. You've mastered the language of the Chakoya and made someone really happy with your generosity. Achuq!
achievement.93.name: Jamjam
achievement.94.description: [EN] Your world is lucky to have you! You don't hesitate to jump in and help when brave heroes are called to save the world.
achievement.94.name: Mi-am făcut partea
achievement.95.description: [EN] You're in the front line when it comes to saving your world or taking part in social events. Whether you do it noticed or unnoticed by the people, your world can rely on you to dutifully do your part to make it a better place for everyone.
achievement.95.name: Notoriu Worldsaver
achievement.96.description: [EN] You don't consider yourself too good to do the dirty work while someone else might win the laurels for killing Devovorga. They couldn't do it without you!
achievement.96.name: Jucător de echipă
achievement.97.description: [EN] You've entered the lair of Devovorga and joined the crew trying to take her down - whether crowned with success or not doesn't matter, but they can't blame you for not trying!
achievement.97.name: Încălcator îndrăzneț
achievement.98.description: [EN] Souls are like butterflies. The black soul of a living weapon yearning to strike lies shattered beneath your feet.
achievement.98.name: [EN] Slayer of Anmothra
achievement.99.description: [EN] Power lies in the will of her who commands it. You fought it with full force - and were stronger.
achievement.99.name: Ucigașul lui Chikhaton
